records.sourceFile: Oxygen straight to the brain - An overview of hyperbaric oxygen therapy for a variety of brain morbidities.pdf
records.degradedReason: The article's own DOI is not printed in the text; the only DOIs present are in the reference list. All other content is complete. Relevance is borderline but not exclusion-level: the paper is published in Current Sports Medicine Reports and its first section covers concussion and post-concussion syndrome, although the treatment evidence comes from veterans, military personnel and general patients rather than athletes.
